scope: Bounded AC1032 DXF parsing and explicit raw-replay preservation for sparse MATERIAL records whose group 94 channel mask is 63.

source.provenance: Pre-existing local sample outside the repository. It was inspected and converted locally; it is not added as a repository fixture.
source.observed: The AC1032 DXF contains sparse MATERIAL records including a group 94 value of 63; one longer record has trailing XDATA.

implementation.behavior: For source version AC1032, the exact group-94 value 63 may mark an incomplete modeled base-map profile for raw-only replay. The reader retains the complete record, including later groups and XDATA. A consumer must explicitly opt into sparse MATERIAL raw capture; the typed writer remains fail-closed.
implementation.limits: This does not establish the semantic meaning of the channel mask, typed MATERIAL support, native rendering, producer breadth, or whole-document conversion eligibility.
